screening.ordering: rotate variants by repeat; reverse convoy

confirmation.ordering: alternate baseline/world-shape by repeat and route

method.cpuMs: process user + system CPU milliseconds per logical tick

method.workloadEquality: All packet hashes, bytes, packet counts, entity counts, peak entity counts and final positions match baseline within each stage/route
method.limit: Every child has a 290-second timeout; no individual run exceeds five minutes. Diagnostic runs excluded from timings.
